summary.text: Dylan Roberts, a Democrat, has represented District 8 in the Colorado State Senate since January 2023, after serving in the Colorado House of Representatives (District 26) from 2017 to 2023.

paragraphs.text: According to Ballotpedia, he advanced from the June 30, 2026 Democratic primary and is on the November 3, 2026 ballot for re-election.

Roberts earned a B.A. from Boston College in 2011 and a J.D. from the University of Colorado in 2016; he is listed as an attorney and previously worked as a deputy district attorney in Colorado's Fifth Judicial District.
As of 2023 he lived in Avon, Colorado.
